govdocs-archive_org-nsia-AMLASH_AMLASH: AMLASH was a CIA cryptonym for a Cuban asset drawn into the agency's plots to kill Fidel Castro, among the most sensitive operations of the Kennedy years. This file holds government material filed under that cryptonym alone, released without a fuller description. Even its bare title ties it to the assassination plots that the Church Committee later exposed to public view. The record is kept as issued, a fragment of the paper trail left by the Castro plots.
